quests.title: A Cover for the Ship
quests.summary: The supply ship is due and the Elder wants a Bounty commemorative cover on it. A little errand around Adamstown.

steps.text: Take the Elder's request to the Postmaster at the Post Office.
Bring the First-Day Cover to Coxswain Rua at Bounty Bay and win your place in the longboat.
Catch a Charkeel on the shingle at Bounty Bay after dark, and show it to the Elder.

quests.reward: A Miro Carving, Pitcairn honey, and the island's good opinion.
